description.value: Minato Japanese Restaurant is a long-established sushi and traditional Japanese restaurant on Vancouver's busy West Broadway corridor, in operation since 1991. The restaurant offers a full dine-in experience alongside delivery and catering services, making it a potential meal stop for cyclists riding one of Vancouver's key east-west routes. It is located in a retail unit at 1001 West Broadway, close to the Cambie Street intersection.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, established Japanese sushi restaurant at #102-1001 W Broadway, Vancouver, operating since 1991, with delivery and catering services; recent posts through March 2026 confirm it is open. OSM contact details (phone 604-732-6554, address) are corroborated by the website. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention any bike-specific amenities — no bike rack, water refill, or washroom information is provided anywhere in the available evidence.
concerns: Website title and header branding uses 'Minato Sushi Restaurant' while the OSM name and website body text both use 'Minato Japanese Restaurant' — OSM name appears correct but the branding inconsistency is noted.

The website contains two conflicting sets of business hours in different sections (contact page versus sidebar footer), suggesting the site may not be fully maintained and data reliability should be treated with caution.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a legitimate, long-operating food and drink establishment on a key cycling corridor, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website or OSM tags; on-site verification is needed before including.
